summary: migration_bridge.py materializes only the declared RED test for one plan slice; supports W0-W6 templates with IDs for typed selection, transport, coverage, knowledge gates, current pointer, retention, and end-to-end migration; validates implementation-contract slice, test selector, planned_new_files, allowed test writes, exact snapshot path, repository/plan boundaries, and forbidden logs/execution-plans components; rejects unknown or undeclared slices, mismatched snapshots, escaping targets, and conflicting existing files; existing identical files are reused; writes UTF-8 tests only when absent; CLI requires --materialize-only and emits materialized status with no authorizations; ambiguity: templates assert future APIs and are intentionally not executed here
